zh.title: 塞爾維亞空軍MiG-29戰機墜毀 飛行員罹難
zh.summary: 塞爾維亞空軍MiG-29在貝爾格勒西北方墜毀，飛行員罹難，國防部成立兩個委員會調查。
body: 塞爾維亞國防部表示，該國空軍與防空部隊一架MiG-29戰鬥機於2026年11月17日在貝爾格勒西北方的Stara Pazova附近墜毀，飛行員Goran Bulajić少校罹難。
國防部指出，失事飛機隸屬第204航空旅，約在當地時間上午8時45分墜落。塞爾維亞媒體報導，墜機地點位於Nova Pazova與Stara Pazova之間的田野。
國防部已成立兩個委員會調查這起事故。一個委員會將調查墜機經過與軍方內部任何可能的責任；另一個空軍與防空部隊的專家委員會將釐清墜機原因。

en.title: Serbian Air Force MiG-29 crashes, killing pilot
en.summary: Serbian Air Force MiG-29 crashes northwest of Belgrade, killing pilot; defense ministry launches investigation.
body: Serbia’s Ministry of Defense said a Serbian Air Force and Air Defense MiG-29 fighter crashed on November 17, 2026, near Stara Pazova, northwest of Belgrade, killing its pilot, Major Goran Bulajić.
The ministry said the aircraft was assigned to the 204th Air Brigade and went down at around 08:45 local time. Serbian media reported that it crashed in a field between Nova Pazova and Stara Pazova.

The ministry has established two commissions to investigate the accident. One will examine the circumstances of the crash and any potential responsibility within the military; a separate Serbian Air Force and Air Defense expert commission will determine the cause.

zh.title: 星宇航空規劃2027年3月開航臺北－雪梨－奧克蘭航線
zh.summary: 星宇航空規劃2027年3月開航臺北－雪梨－奧克蘭，初期每週4班。
body: 星宇航空宣佈，規劃在2027年3月23日開航臺北－雪梨－奧克蘭新航線。這將是星宇航空成立以來，首次將航網延伸至大洋洲。
星宇航空表示，新航線預計以A330-900機型執飛，開航初期每週4班，並自5月1日起增為每日1班。
公司指出，隨著雪梨及奧克蘭雙航點啟航，將透過與澳洲航空（Qantas）的合作，把聯程航網延伸至多條航線。
此外，星宇航空預計，整體機隊規模將於2027年底前增加至48架。

en.title: STARLUX Airlines plans Taipei–Sydney–Auckland service for March 2027
en.summary: STARLUX Airlines plans a Taipei–Sydney–Auckland route in March 2027, initially with four weekly flights.
body: STARLUX Airlines plans to launch a Taipei–Sydney–Auckland route on March 23, 2027. The planned service would extend its network into Oceania for the first time.
The airline said it plans to use an A330-900 aircraft on the route. Four flights a week are planned initially, increasing to one a day from May 1.
The company said its connecting network will extend to multiple routes through cooperation with Qantas as the two destinations are added.
Separately, STARLUX Airlines expects its fleet to grow to 48 aircraft by the end of 2027.

zh.title: Azul首架SkyCourier飛機投入亞馬遜載運石油工人
zh.summary: 巴西Azul Conecta首架19座Cessna SkyCourier已於11月3日投入服務，為巴西石油公司載運亞馬遜油田工人；這架飛機同時開放一般旅客購票搭乘往返瑪瑙斯的每週航班。
body: 巴西區域航空Azul Conecta首架Cessna SkyCourier已投入服務，為巴西石油公司（Petrobras）載運巴西亞馬遜地區的油田工人；這架19座雙發動機渦輪螺旋槳飛機同時開放一般旅客購票搭乘往返瑪瑙斯的每週航班。這架註冊號PS-ENE的飛機於11月3日投入服務；Azul贏得為期四年的合約，為巴西石油公司載運工人，該公司在亞馬遜州的業務包括波爾圖烏魯庫油氣田。

依Azul向CNN Brasil說明的班表，SkyCourier每週五自卡勞阿里出發，經科阿里前往州首府瑪瑙斯；週一反向飛行。即使與巴西石油公司無關的旅客也可購票搭乘。19座的SkyCourier載客量是Azul Conecta九座Cessna大篷車（Grand Caravan）的兩倍以上；Azul Conecta執行長Vitor Cordeiro表示，數條區域航線的客量已超出大篷車的承載能力，但仍不足以改用ATR 72，巴西石油公司的合約讓這次採購得以實現。
Azul Conecta預計2027年上半年接收第二架SkyCourier；執行長考慮的目的地之一是亞馬遜釣魚小鎮巴塞洛斯，該航點目前由大篷車執飛。對前往當地的旅客而言，大型飛機的優勢在於行李艙空間，釣客常攜帶體積龐大的釣具，而大篷車的空間有限。Azul尚未確定SkyCourier飛往巴塞洛斯的日期。

en.title: Azul airline puts first Cessna SkyCourier to work flying oil crews in the Amazon
en.summary: Azul Conecta's first 19-seat Cessna SkyCourier entered service on November 3, flying oil crews for Petrobras in the Brazilian Amazon, with seats on its weekly Manaus flights also sold to the public.
body: Azul Conecta has put its first Cessna SkyCourier to work flying oil crews for Petrobras in the Brazilian Amazon, and also plans to sell seats on the weekly flights that bring the 19-seat turboprop back to Manaus and return it to the oilfields. The aircraft, registered PS-ENE, entered service on November 3, 2026. Azul won a four-year contract to transport workers for the Brazilian oil company, whose operations in the state of Amazonas include the oil and gas fields at Porto Urucu.

Under the schedule Azul outlined to CNN Brasil, the SkyCourier will leave Carauari on Fridays, stop in Coari and continue to Manaus, the state capital, flying the route in reverse on Mondays. Passengers can buy seats on those flights even if they have no connection to Petrobras. With 19 seats, the twin-engine SkyCourier can carry more than twice as many passengers as Azul Conecta's nine-seat Cessna Grand Caravans. Chief Executive Vitor Cordeiro told Brazilian outlet UOL that several of the airline's regional routes have outgrown the Caravan but still draw too few passengers to warrant an ATR 72, and that the Petrobras contract helped make the purchase possible.

Azul Conecta expects its second SkyCourier in the first half of 2027. One destination Cordeiro is considering is Barcelos, an Amazon fishing town the airline already serves by Caravan. For passengers heading there, the appeal of the larger Cessna may be in the baggage hold, as anglers often bring bulky tackle along with their luggage and space aboard the Caravan is limited. Azul has yet to set a date for SkyCourier flights to Barcelos.

zh.title: A380新創航空Global Airlines遭英國法院下令強制清算　唯一客機仍停放法國
zh.summary: 英國法院11月4日對Global Airlines發出強制清算令，12日正式公告；這家以A380跨大西洋航線為目標的新創業者，曾短暫執行4個載客航段。
body: 英國航空新創公司Global Airlines遭法院下令強制清算。根據英國官方公示刊物《The London Gazette》11月12日發布的通知，英國高等法院於2026年11月4日對Global Airlines Ltd（公司編號13508008）發出清算令，並指派官方接管人處理相關程序。這項裁定源自今年5月29日提出的清算聲請，使公司以空中巴士A380重返跨大西洋市場的計畫面臨重大轉折。

Global Airlines由James Asquith於2021年創立，以大型雙層客機、較高規格的客艙服務與英美航線為營運訴求。公司雖然曾提出多架A380的機隊構想，始終未取得自己的航空營運許可（AOC）。2025年5月，Global Airlines曾透過Hi Fly Malta濕租執飛英國與美國紐約之間的載客服務；根據Flightradar24統計，當時共完成4個載客航段，未發展為持續運作的定期航線。
Global Airlines唯一已取得的A380註冊編號為9H-GLOBL，原先由中國南方航空營運，2025年7月起停放在法國塔布機場。法院發出清算令後，公司資產及債務將依司法與清算程序處理；這並不直接確定該架A380最終會由誰接手。本文配圖為9H-GLOBL於2025年7月抵達塔布的資料照片，並非清算程序現場。

en.title: UK court orders Global Airlines into compulsory liquidation; lone A380 remains stored in France
en.summary: A UK High Court winding-up order issued on November 4 against Global Airlines Ltd was published on November 12, while its sole Airbus A380 remains stored at Tarbes.
body: British A380 startup Global Airlines Ltd has been placed into compulsory liquidation by court order. According to a notice published in The London Gazette on November 12, 2026, the High Court of Justice made a winding-up order on November 4, following a petition filed on May 29. An official receiver has been appointed to oversee the process, creating a substantial setback for the company's proposed transatlantic Airbus A380 operations.

Founded in 2021 by James Asquith, Global Airlines aimed to offer premium services between the UK and North America using the double-deck Airbus A380. It never obtained its own air operator certificate. In May 2025, it briefly offered flights between Britain and New York operated on a wet-lease basis by Hi Fly Malta. Flightradar24 reported that four revenue flight sectors were completed, without any subsequent sustained scheduled operation.

The only Airbus A380 acquired by the company, registration 9H-GLOBL, previously flew with China Southern Airlines and has been stored at Tarbes in France since July 2025. The winding-up order initiates a formal legal process to address assets and liabilities; it does not itself establish the aircraft's eventual disposition. The accompanying photograph shows 9H-GLOBL arriving at Tarbes in July 2025, not the 2026 court proceedings.

zh.title: 中國商飛CE-25A電動飛機完成首次載人試飛　19座設計邁入下一階段
zh.summary: 中國商飛CE-25A於11月14日在山東濱州完成首次載人試飛，機上有2名飛行員與1名試飛工程師，先前已完成19次無人飛行驗證。
body: 中國商飛（COMAC）研發的CE-25A全電動飛機於2026年11月14日在山東省濱州完成首次載人試飛。根據中國民用航空局發布的消息，飛機搭載兩名飛行員與一名試飛工程師，試飛過程中各系統運作正常，性能指標達到預期。這項進展代表CE-25A正式進入載人試驗階段，但距離取得適航認證及投入商業服務仍有後續程序。
航空媒體AeroTime報導，CE-25A此次在空中飛行16分38秒、航程60.4公里；連同地面作業的完整測試歷時57分46秒。自今年2月2日首次無人自主飛行以來，該機已進行19次無人飛行驗證。其設計採用分布式電動涵道風扇推進，公布規格包含最多19個乘客座位、最大起飛重量10公噸、每小時300公里巡航速度，以及約400公里航程。
CE-25A由中國商飛與寧德時代、上海交通大學等合作開發。中國民航局表示已受理這款飛機的型號合格證申請；這代表審定程序已有進展，但不等於完成核准。SKYTICAL在10月底曾報導CE-25A機身照片引起討論，這次正式公布的載人試飛，讓外界得以進一步確認專案進度。本文配圖為CE-25A創作示意圖，並非試飛現場照片。

en.title: COMAC CE-25A makes first piloted test flight as electric commuter project advances
en.summary: COMAC's CE-25A completed its first piloted flight on November 14 in Shandong with two pilots and a flight-test engineer, following 19 unmanned validation flights.
body: COMAC's CE-25A electric commuter aircraft completed its first piloted test flight at Binzhou in Shandong province on November 14, 2026. According to a report published by the Civil Aviation Administration of China, two pilots and a flight-test engineer were aboard. COMAC said the aircraft's systems operated normally and test indicators met expectations. A successful piloted test does not constitute type certification or approval for commercial passenger service.

AeroTime reported 16 minutes and 38 seconds of airborne time covering 60.4 kilometers, with the full test activity lasting 57 minutes and 46 seconds. The programme previously completed 19 unmanned validation flights, starting on February 2. The aircraft is designed around distributed electric ducted fans and is intended to carry up to 19 passengers, with a published maximum takeoff weight of 10 tonnes, cruise speed of 300 km/h and range of around 400 kilometers.

COMAC is developing the type with partners including CATL and Shanghai Jiao Tong University. China's aviation authority has accepted an application for a type certificate, but certification work is ongoing. Earlier unverified images of a CE-25A prototype had prompted debate about the programme's status; the confirmed flight provides a stronger milestone. The accompanying CC0 illustration is not a photo of the November 14 flight.

zh.title: 航空短訊彙整：Azul首架SkyCourier飛機投入亞馬遜載運石油工人、A380新創航空Global Airlines遭英國法院下令強制清算　唯一客機仍停放法國、中國商飛CE-25A電動飛機完成首次載人試飛　19座設計邁入下一階段
zh.summary: 本期收錄3則獨立消息：Azul首架SkyCourier飛機投入亞馬遜載運石油工人、A380新創航空Global Airlines遭英國法院下令強制清算　唯一客機仍停放法國、中國商飛CE-25A電動飛機完成首次載人試飛　19座設計邁入下一階段。
body: 本期彙整3則航空短訊，各則為獨立事件。部分內容摘自近期站內報導，原文與來源見文末。

1. Azul首架SkyCourier飛機投入亞馬遜載運石油工人
巴西Azul Conecta首架19座Cessna SkyCourier已於11月3日投入服務，為巴西石油公司載運亞馬遜油田工人；這架飛機同時開放一般旅客購票搭乘往返瑪瑙斯的每週航班。

2. A380新創航空Global Airlines遭英國法院下令強制清算　唯一客機仍停放法國
英國法院11月4日對Global Airlines發出強制清算令，12日正式公告；這家以A380跨大西洋航線為目標的新創業者，曾短暫執行4個載客航段。

3. 中國商飛CE-25A電動飛機完成首次載人試飛　19座設計邁入下一階段
中國商飛CE-25A於11月14日在山東濱州完成首次載人試飛，機上有2名飛行員與1名試飛工程師，先前已完成19次無人飛行驗證。

en.title: Aviation briefs: Azul airline puts first Cessna SkyCourier to work flying oil crews in the Amazon; UK court orders Global Airlines into compulsory liquidation; lone A380 remains stored in France; COMAC CE-25A makes first piloted test flight as electric commuter project advances
en.summary: 3 independent updates: Azul airline puts first Cessna SkyCourier to work flying oil crews in the Amazon; UK court orders Global Airlines into compulsory liquidation; lone A380 remains stored in France; COMAC CE-25A makes first piloted test flight as electric commuter project advances.
body: 3 independent aviation updates. Includes excerpts of recent reports, with original reports and sources linked below.

1. Azul airline puts first Cessna SkyCourier to work flying oil crews in the Amazon
Azul Conecta's first 19-seat Cessna SkyCourier entered service on November 3, flying oil crews for Petrobras in the Brazilian Amazon, with seats on its weekly Manaus flights also sold to the public.

2. UK court orders Global Airlines into compulsory liquidation; lone A380 remains stored in France
A UK High Court winding-up order issued on November 4 against Global Airlines Ltd was published on November 12, while its sole Airbus A380 remains stored at Tarbes.

3. COMAC CE-25A makes first piloted test flight as electric commuter project advances
COMAC's CE-25A completed its first piloted flight on November 14 in Shandong with two pilots and a flight-test engineer, following 19 unmanned validation flights.
